title: MUSER: A Multi-View Similar Case Retrieval Dataset
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on similar case retrieval for Chinese civil law.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on legal case retrieval in the domain of Chinese civil law.
